name: v1_reference_setup
description: The v1 dam-break configuration, reproduced exactly, so the Phase 0 physics changes can be measured against it rather than argued about.
approximation: Not part of the scenario library. This exists only as the controlled 'before' case for the docs/architecture.md Phase 0 comparison: same domain, same column, same h, same c0, same clamp-and-damp walls as the v1 solver, so the only differences are the physics fixes themselves.
